summary: Recent updates to the compositing and layers area of the Firefox browser enhance how visual elements are rendered, particularly for high dynamic range (HDR) video. A significant change allows for the **_enqueuing of HDR video surfaces with extended dynamic range_**, improving the overall quality of video playback by providing greater color depth and brightness levels. Additionally, improvements to the handling of image rendering, such as clamping WebRender mask placement to the appropriate region and managing scroll-linked properties, aim to boost performance and visual fidelity in various scenarios. These enhancements collectively help ensure a smoother and more immersive experience for users, especially when interacting with multimedia content.
